BATCH-WIDE SENTINEL (the Phase I/II operator-owner question I was asked to settle for the whole cohort, filed from this row because it is the row that owed both an Owner ref and an Operator second source). Three parts, as asked: (i) what the authoritative mapping actually is, (ii) which rows in this run carry a sheet phase label or an owner/operator attribution the sources contradict, (iii) what the merge should do. All quotations below are from bodies I fetched and extracted myself this pass; I did not re-research any other row's physical specs, only read their shards.

=== (i) THE AUTHORITATIVE MAPPING ===
CCXI 2022 (qixin PDF), footnote 1, verbatim: '目前，江西省共有两家省级天然气长输管道运营商，分别为江西省天然气管道有限公司（以下简称"天然气管道公司"）和江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司（以下简称"管道分公司"），其中天然气管道公司负责投资建设及运营承接川气东送气源的一期管网，为公司控股 54%股权的一级子公司；管道分公司承接西气东输二线气源的二期管网工程。'
SSE 242696 (2025-04-03), footnote 5, verbatim: '天然气集团持有天然气管道公司 54%的股权，剩余 46%股权由国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司（原"中国石化管道储运有限公司"）持有。'
So the mapping is, exactly:
  PHASE I (一期管网) -- gas source 川气东送 -- network company 江西省天然气管道有限公司 (Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Co., Ltd.), owned 54% 江西省天然气集团有限公司 / 46% 国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司; day-to-day operations run through its 运营分公司 (jxsggzy 2019-10-28).
  PHASE II (二期管网) -- gas source 西气东输二线 -- built and run by 江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司, a BRANCH of the group, i.e. 100% group, no PipeChina equity.

The same 管道分公司 is let out under four different parents across four tenders I read: 江西省天然气管道有限公司管道分公司 (2020-04, section 1.2), 江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司 (2020-04, contact block -- the SAME document), 江西省天然气（赣投气通）控股有限公司管道分公司 (2017-12), and, separately, 江西省天然气投资有限公司 letting a 二期 procurement outright (2016-11).
